sites.lesson: Show the working artifact at a readable scale.
Group technical entry points by the task.
Consistency makes actions and reading predictable.
Connect a public purpose to inspectable research objects.
Make useful artifacts and contributors visible.
Define the mechanism before presenting a broad ecosystem.
Offer concrete participation paths beside the mission.
Use dated project rows to convey real work.
Pair an entry action with an understandable workflow.
Use hierarchy and deliberate section contrast.
